fields.label: Use Time-Varying Litterfall Rate
fields.help: Check the box to use values that vary in time for coniferous forest leaf litterfall rate (fraction per day of plant leaves falling to the ground). This feature is not typically used for this plant type. For evergreen leaves, it is typically assumed that the litterfall is slow and constant.

fields.label: Field Name for Values of Coniferous Forest Litterfall
fields.help: Indicate the field name for the time-varying values of coniferous forest litterfall rate.

fields.label: Static Value for Coniferous Forest Litterfall Rate (per day)
fields.help: Enter a single value of coniferous forest litterfall rate to use throughout your model run (the default value of 0.0021 for this plant type assumes that 99% of leaves fall over 6 years).
